A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GRACE teacher-selection work. Their 44 pages, including figures, tables, equations and Appendices A-F, support a complete comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original distillation experiments, teacher-selection correlations and regrets, ablations, ARC results and out-of-distribution evaluations in Section 3 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results across multiple student models, teachers and benchmarks.

M1.justification: The gradient processing, cross-validation construction and GRACE equations remain unchanged, as does the distillation procedure. No algorithmic component is added or removed.

E1.justification: The GSM8K, MATH, ARC and supplementary evaluation coverage is retained. Figure 11's caption changes MATH to GSM8K, correcting its label to match the Gemma-2B experiment already described in Sections 3 and D.1.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparator set is unchanged. Although Figure 6 adds explicit Loss curves for its two example teachers, Loss already participates in the same temperature evaluation through the aggregate panel in v1.

E3.justification: Training budgets, model configurations, sampling temperatures, gradient settings and evaluation metrics are unchanged. Figure 6's sign reversal for displaying G-Norm and conversion of accuracy from fractions to percentages are plotting changes.

E4.justification: Figure 6 expands the existing temperature-sensitivity case study with pointwise student-loss trajectories for Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, supplementing v1's correlation summaries. The appendix ablations, robustness tests, out-of-distribution analyses and qualitative studies are unchanged.

E5.justification: There are no changes to repeated-run information, uncertainty estimation or statistical reporting practices. The teacher-subset distributions in Appendix E.5 and Figure 29 are unchanged; Figure 6 already used per-teacher correlation distributions in v1.

E6.justification: Figure 1 changes teacher-performance correlations from 0.44/0.76 to 0.11/0.67 on GSM8K/MATH, with Loss changing oppositely; v3 now agrees with the unchanged Figure 4. Figure 6 changes the G-Norm/Loss summary assignments from 0.53/0.55 to 0.55/0.53 and adds Loss-temperature curves. These are limited reporting revisions, without evidence of improved GRACE performance or rerun experiments.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, LOO-CMI bounds, assumptions, corollaries and proof in Appendix C are unchanged. The main-text gradient-update equation moves across a page boundary without mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same claims about GRACE's teacher-selection utility, theoretical connection, predictive performance and practical distillation guidance.

C2.justification: The diversity/alignment interpretation and stated limitations remain unchanged, including the theory-practice gap, adversarial repetition example and imperfect predictive behavior beyond mathematics.

D1.justification: The disclosed hyperparameters, learning-rate search, hardware, computational costs, vLLM version and prompt templates are unchanged. Training details move between pages but are not newly disclosed.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive related-work positioning are unchanged. The added acknowledgements do not introduce research comparisons or novelty claims.

P1.justification: v3 adds an acknowledgements section and updates the version/date text and Figure 11's dataset wording. The scientific prose and section organization otherwise remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 6 is redrawn with an additional Loss curve, sign-adjusted G-Norm curves, revised legends and violin labels, and percentage accuracy axes. Figure 11's caption is corrected, equation spacing is tightened, and some text and references reflow. The remaining displays are largely unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting Figure 1 to agree with Figure 4 and fixing Figure 11's dataset label removes concrete reporting errors. Figure 6 also better follows its stated plotting convention, although its revised G-Norm summary of 0.55 is not reconciled with the prose's magnitude of 0.53. These changes provide a limited net gain in clarity and consistency without substantively strengthening the experimental or theoretical foundation.
